values.meaning: Mini Gnar (Hop) Physical Damage on bounce
Mega Gnar (Crunch) Physical Damage on impact
Crunch shockwave Physical Damage (same as impact) to additional enemies
values.quote: sends out a shockwave, dealing the same damage to additional enemies in a larger radius
After a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, '''Gnar''' sends out a shockwave
values.binNote: No bin row for this shockwave delay; GnarE.TravelTime (0.6) is the dash travel time, a different number, so it cannot be cited here.

mechanics.claim: Hop bounces off any unit it lands on and leaps again 500 units further; only landing on an enemy deals damage and slows.
mechanics.quote: If '''Gnar''' lands on a unit he will {{tip|dash|bounce}} 500 units further in the same direction. Landing on an enemy deals them {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: If Hop is used to transform into Mega Gnar it does not grant bonus attack speed, and instead the shockwave (Crunch) fires where he lands after bouncing.
mechanics.quote: If ''Hop'' is used to transform, it will not grant {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. Instead, after {{tip|dash|bouncing}} '''Gnar''' will send out a shockwave as per ''{{ai|Crunch|Gnar}}''

mechanics.claim: Gnar will not bounce if immobilized during the first leap.
mechanics.quote: '''Gnar''' will not bounce if he is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} during the first leap.

mechanics.claim: Crunch deals damage on impact to nearby enemies, then after a delay deals the same damage again via a shockwave to a larger radius, hitting a separate set of enemies.
mechanics.quote: '''Gnar''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location and deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon impact ... After a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, '''Gnar''' sends out a shockwave, dealing the same damage to additional enemies in a larger radius.

mechanics.claim: Gnar is locked out of using any other abilities during Crunch.
mechanics.quote: '''Gnar''' is locked out of using any other abilities during ''Crunch''.

mechanics.claim: Boulder Toss can be cast during the Hop dash.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}} can be cast during the dash.''
